mcq.q: Which book of the Bible begins with the words "In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth"?
mcq.explanation: Genesis 1:1 is the opening line of the Bible.

mcq.q: What does it mean to say that God is the sole Creator?
options: God had many helpers in creation
mcq.explanation: Sole means only. God alone made everything.

mcq.q: According to Genesis 1:27, human beings were created in the what of God?
mcq.explanation: Genesis 1:27 says that God created human beings in His own image.

mcq.q: Why does no other person have the same fingerprints as you?
mcq.explanation: Fingerprints show that each person is one of a kind.

mcq.q: Which Bible passage says that we are fearfully and wonderfully made?
mcq.explanation: Psalm 139:14 speaks of being fearfully and wonderfully made.

mcq.q: Why is knowing your full name important for your safety?
options: You can tell a helper who you are if you get lost
You can hide it from your parents
You can use it to tease others
mcq.explanation: A name helps people identify you and help you find your family.

mcq.q: Zawadi is a Kiswahili name. What does it mean?
mcq.explanation: Zawadi means a gift in Kiswahili.

mcq.q: A child says, "I am better than others because I am unique." What is wrong with this idea?
options: Everyone is unique, so nobody is better because of it
mcq.explanation: All people are unique and special to God, so it is not a reason to boast.

mcq.q: Which statement about God and human beings is true?
options: God knows each person by name
mcq.explanation: Isaiah 43:1 says that God calls His people by name.

mcq.q: What is the best way to respond when someone teases you about your appearance?
options: Remember that God made you special and tell a trusted adult if it continues
mcq.explanation: God's view of you matters more than unkind words.

mcq.q: Which of these is a good use of your talents?
mcq.explanation: Talents are gifts from God meant to serve others.

mcq.q: Which of these shows respect for the differences among people?
options: Playing with children from different backgrounds
Leaving out children who look different
Giving people nicknames about their bodies
mcq.explanation: Respecting differences shows that we value all of God's creation.

mcq.q: Who chose your name in most families?
mcq.explanation: Parents or guardians usually give a child a name at birth.

mcq.q: Which of these things was created by God, according to the Bible?
mcq.explanation: Genesis 1 says that God made the sun, moon and stars, and also the land, sea, plants and animals.

mcq.q: Which is an example of a good thought?
options: I will take my friend's book
I will help my mother with the dishes
mcq.explanation: Helping at home is a thought that leads to kindness.

mcq.q: Which verse tells Christians to rejoice in the Lord always?
mcq.explanation: Philippians 4:4 says, "Rejoice in the Lord always."

mcq.q: What does Ephesians 4:26 teach about anger?
options: Do not sin in your anger and do not stay angry for long
mcq.explanation: The verse says that we should not sin when angry and should settle it quickly.

mcq.q: Which is a healthy way to calm down when you feel angry?
options: Take deep breaths and count to ten
mcq.explanation: Slowing down helps you to think before acting.

mcq.q: Feelings such as happiness, sadness and anger are:
options: Normal, but our actions must be right
mcq.explanation: Feelings themselves are not bad. What we do with them matters.

mcq.q: What is joy, as a Christian understands it?
options: A deep gladness that comes from knowing God loves us
mcq.explanation: Christian joy is based on God's love, not on our circumstances.

mcq.q: Which of these can help a child who is sad?
options: Talking to a trusted adult and praying
mcq.explanation: Sharing feelings with a trusted person and praying helps.

mcq.q: A classmate is sitting alone and looks sad. What should you do?
options: Sit with them and kindly ask what is wrong
mcq.explanation: Kindness and listening help a sad friend.

mcq.q: Which thought is likely to lead to a wrong action?
options: I want to take what is not mine
mcq.explanation: Wanting to take what belongs to others leads to stealing.

mcq.q: According to Philippians 4:8, what should Christians think about?
options: Whatever is true, pure and lovely
mcq.explanation: Philippians 4:8 lists true, noble, right, pure and lovely things.

mcq.q: Why is it good to name your feeling, such as saying "I am angry"?
options: It helps you to decide what to do about it
mcq.explanation: Naming feelings makes them easier to handle.

mcq.q: What should you do before the day ends if you have quarrelled with a friend?
mcq.explanation: Ephesians 4:26 says not to let the sun go down on your anger.

mcq.q: How can a smile help others?
options: It can cheer up a person who is tired or sad
mcq.explanation: Small acts of kindness like a smile encourage others.

mcq.q: What is a choice?
options: A decision to do one thing instead of another
mcq.explanation: A choice means deciding between different actions.

mcq.q: What is a consequence?
options: A result of what we choose
mcq.explanation: A consequence is the result of a choice.

mcq.q: Which verse says that God's word is a lamp for our feet?
mcq.explanation: Psalm 119:105 compares God's word to a lamp and a light.

mcq.q: Which choice is likely to bring a good result?
mcq.explanation: Doing your work first helps you learn and stay out of trouble.

mcq.q: Which person in the Bible chose not to defile himself with the king's food?
mcq.explanation: Daniel 1:8 says that he decided not to defile himself.

mcq.q: Who said, "As for me and my household, we will serve the Lord"?
mcq.explanation: Joshua 24:15 records these words.

mcq.q: You find a Ksh 100 note in the classroom. What is the right choice?
options: Spend it at the school shop
Give it to the teacher to find the owner
mcq.explanation: Honesty means returning what is not ours.

mcq.q: What should you do first when you must make a difficult choice?
mcq.explanation: Thinking first helps us to choose well.

mcq.q: Which question helps you to choose rightly?
options: Will I get away with it?
Does this agree with what God teaches?
mcq.explanation: We measure choices by God's word.

mcq.q: A friend invites you to skip class and play. What is the best choice?
options: Politely say no and go to class
mcq.explanation: Skipping class is wrong and harms learning.

mcq.q: Which is a result of a bad choice such as fighting?
mcq.explanation: Fighting often brings pain, trouble and lost friendships.

mcq.q: Which choice affects other people besides yourself?
options: Choosing which shoe to wear first
mcq.explanation: Littering makes the compound dirty for everyone.

mcq.q: What should you do if you make a wrong choice?
options: Admit it, say sorry and try to put it right
mcq.explanation: Being honest about mistakes lets us make things right.

mcq.q: Who is included in the nuclear family?
mcq.explanation: The nuclear family is the small group of parents and children living together.

mcq.q: Who is your cousin?
options: The child of your aunt or uncle
mcq.explanation: Cousins are the children of your uncles and aunts.

mcq.q: Who are your grandparents?
options: The parents of your mother or father
mcq.explanation: Grandparents are the mothers and fathers of your parents.

mcq.q: In a family tree, where are the grandparents normally placed?
options: In the middle with the children
mcq.explanation: A family tree shows the oldest generation at the top.

mcq.q: Which Bible passage tells children to obey their parents in the Lord?
mcq.explanation: Ephesians 6:1-3 tells children to obey and honour their parents.

mcq.q: What does it mean to honour your parents?
options: To respect them, obey them and thank them
mcq.explanation: Honouring includes respect, obedience and thankfulness.

mcq.q: Which of these is part of the extended family?
mcq.explanation: Uncles are relatives outside the nuclear family.

mcq.q: Which action shows respect for a grandmother?
mcq.explanation: Helping shows respect and care.

mcq.q: Why is it important to know your family members?
options: It helps you to greet them and understand how you are related
mcq.explanation: Knowing family helps in respect and relationships.

mcq.q: Which commandment says, "Honour your father and your mother"?
mcq.explanation: Exodus 20:12 is the commandment on honouring parents.

mcq.q: Which of these is a way of respecting family members at home?
options: Greeting politely and helping with chores
mcq.explanation: Polite words and helpful actions build peace at home.

mcq.q: A child lives with a grandmother and an aunt because her parents work far away. Is this a family?
options: No, only parents and children make a family
No, it is only a group of neighbours
Yes, every family that cares for a child should be respected
mcq.explanation: Families come in different forms, and each deserves love and respect.

mcq.q: What brings harmony in a family?
mcq.explanation: Respect and love make a home peaceful.

mcq.q: What does 1 Corinthians 6:19 say our bodies are?
mcq.explanation: The verse teaches that the body is a temple of the Holy Spirit.

mcq.q: Which parts of the body are private?
options: The parts covered by underwear or a swimming costume
mcq.explanation: Private parts are those covered by underwear.

mcq.q: Which of these is a safe touch?
options: Touching your private parts by a stranger
A touch you have been told to keep secret
mcq.explanation: A hug from a parent is safe and loving.

mcq.q: What should you say if someone tries to touch your private parts?
mcq.explanation: Say no loudly and clearly, then move away.

mcq.q: Whom should you tell if someone touches you in a wrong way?
options: A trusted adult such as a parent or teacher
mcq.explanation: A trusted adult can protect you.

mcq.q: Which number can a child in Kenya call for help, as given in the lesson?
mcq.explanation: Childline Kenya can be reached free on 116.

mcq.q: Someone offers you sweets and asks you to keep a secret. What should you do?
options: Refuse and tell a trusted adult
mcq.explanation: Gifts with secrets are a warning sign.

mcq.q: If a child is hurt by someone, whose fault is it?
mcq.explanation: It is never the child's fault.

mcq.q: What is a good rule when you are alone with people?
options: Be careful and stay in open places
mcq.explanation: Safe places and caution protect you.

mcq.q: Why should Christians respect their bodies?
options: The body is a temple of the Holy Spirit
mcq.explanation: 1 Corinthians 6:19 gives this reason.

mcq.q: If the first adult you tell does not help you, what should you do?
mcq.explanation: Keep telling until someone helps.

mcq.q: Which Old Testament chapter tells the sad story of Tamar?
mcq.explanation: The story of Tamar is in 2 Samuel 13.

short.q: Give two things that make each person unique.
short.answer: Fingerprints, voice, face, talents, likes and dislikes. Any two.
short.working: 1 mark for each valid answer.

short.q: Explain why we should thank God for making us.
short.answer: God created us in His image and planned each of us. He gave us life, family and talents. Thanking Him shows that we value His gifts.
short.working: 1 mark for God creating us, 1 for the gifts of life or talents, 1 for the link to giving thanks.

short.q: State four ways of looking after your body as God's special creation.
short.answer: Eat healthy food, keep clean, rest and exercise, avoid harmful things such as drugs, do not hurt yourself or others.
short.working: 1 mark for each valid way, up to 4.

short.q: Explain how Genesis 1:27 and Psalm 139 help a child who feels unimportant.
short.answer: Genesis 1:27 says people are made in God's image, so every person is valuable. Psalm 139 says we are fearfully and wonderfully made, so God took great care in making us. God also knows us by name. Therefore no child is unimportant, and we should respect ourselves and others.
short.working: 1 mark for Genesis 1:27 meaning, 1 for Psalm 139 meaning, 1 for God knowing us by name, 1 for the conclusion, 1 for a clear link to the child's feelings.

short.q: State two ways of coping with anger.
short.answer: Breathe deeply, count to ten, walk away, talk to a trusted adult, pray. Any two.
short.working: 1 mark for each valid way.

short.q: Why is being joyful important for a Christian? Give three reasons.
short.answer: It keeps us healthy in mind; it cheers others; it helps us face problems; it shows trust in God. Any three.
short.working: 1 mark for each valid reason.

short.q: Describe four steps you can follow when you feel very angry with someone.
short.answer: Stop and breathe, count to ten, walk away if needed, tell a trusted adult, pray, forgive and make peace.
short.working: 1 mark for each valid step, up to 4.

short.q: Explain Ephesians 4:26 and show how a child can apply it when a friend has hurt them.
short.answer: Ephesians 4:26 says to be angry without sinning and not to keep the anger overnight. A child should calm down, avoid hitting or insulting, talk to the friend kindly or ask an adult to help, forgive, and pray for peace before the day ends.
short.working: 1 mark for the meaning of the verse, 1 for not sinning in anger, 1 for calming down, 1 for talking or forgiving, 1 for prayer or making peace quickly.

short.q: State two choices that you make at home every day.
short.answer: Whether to do chores, to obey parents, to share food, to be kind to siblings. Any two.
short.working: 1 mark for each valid choice.

short.q: Give three steps you can follow to make a right choice.
short.answer: Stop and think; ask if it agrees with God's word; think about who is helped or hurt; pray; ask a trusted adult.
short.working: 1 mark for each valid step, up to 3.

short.q: Explain what Psalm 119:105 teaches about how the Bible helps us to make right choices.
short.answer: A lamp lights the path so that we can see where to step. The Bible shows us what is right and wrong so that we can choose safely. It guides us in the dark, that is, when we are confused.
short.working: 1 mark for the lamp picture, 1 for guidance to right and wrong, 1 for use when confused, 1 for a clear link to choices.

short.q: Describe how Daniel made a right choice in Babylon and give two lessons a child can learn from him.
short.answer: Daniel decided not to defile himself with the king's food and politely asked for permission to eat differently. Lessons: it is good to stay faithful to God even when far from home or when no one is watching; we can stand for what is right politely and respectfully; God blesses those who stay faithful.
short.working: 1 mark for describing the decision, 1 for politeness or asking permission, 2 for two lessons, 1 for clear expression.

short.q: Name two members of the extended family.
short.answer: Grandfather, grandmother, uncle, aunt, cousin. Any two.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct member.

short.q: Give three ways of showing respect to family members.
short.answer: Greet politely, obey, help with chores, speak kindly, share, pray for them.
short.working: 1 mark for each valid way, up to 3.

short.q: Explain the difference between the nuclear family and the extended family, with one example of each member.
short.answer: The nuclear family is parents and children living together, for example a mother. The extended family includes other relatives such as grandparents, aunts, uncles and cousins, for example an uncle.
short.working: 1 mark for describing nuclear, 1 for example, 1 for describing extended, 1 for example.

short.q: Explain four reasons why children should honour their parents.
short.answer: God commands it (Exodus 20:12); parents care for us; it brings peace at home; it brings God's blessing; it sets an example for younger children.
short.working: 1 mark for each valid reason up to 4, and 1 mark for a clear explanation.

short.q: Name two people you can tell if you are touched in a way that makes you unsafe.
short.answer: Parent, guardian, teacher, pastor, nurse, police officer. Any two.
short.working: 1 mark for each valid person.

short.q: Give three ways in which a child can protect themselves from sexual abuse.
short.answer: Say no loudly, run away, do not accept gifts from strangers, avoid being alone in hidden places, tell a trusted adult.
short.working: 1 mark for each valid way.

short.q: Describe what a child should do step by step if someone touches them wrongly.
short.answer: Say no loudly, move away quickly to a safe place with people, shout for help if needed, tell a trusted adult right away even if told to keep it secret.
short.working: 1 mark for each valid step, up to 4.

short.q: Explain why a child should never blame themselves if they were touched wrongly, and say what they should do.
short.answer: The person who did wrong is always guilty. A child cannot control an adult or older person who chooses to do wrong. The child should tell a trusted adult, who will believe and protect them, and can call 116 for help.
short.working: 1 mark for the person doing wrong being guilty, 1 for the child not being to blame, 1 for telling a trusted adult, 1 for the helper protecting, 1 for the helpline.

short.q: List two attributes of God.
short.answer: Sole Creator, loving Father, holy. Any two.
short.working: 1 mark for each attribute.

short.q: Explain what the word "sole" means when we say God is the sole Creator.
short.answer: Sole means only. God alone made everything. Nobody helped Him and nobody made Him.
short.working: 1 mark for meaning of sole, 1 for God alone creating, 1 for no helper.

short.q: Describe four ways in which God shows that He is a loving Father.
short.answer: He gives life, food, water and air; gives families; forgives when we are sorry; knows us by name; sent Jesus to save us.
short.working: 1 mark for each valid way, up to 4.

short.q: Explain how knowing that God is holy should affect the way a child behaves.
short.answer: God is pure and never does wrong, so we should respect Him, worship Him and try to be holy. We should choose good things, tell the truth, avoid sin, behave well in church and obey His commandments. If we fail, we should say sorry.
short.working: 1 mark for God being holy, 1 for respect, 1 for choosing good, 1 for avoiding sin or obeying, 1 for saying sorry.

short.q: Write the first three books of the New Testament in order.
short.answer: Matthew, Mark, Luke.
short.working: 1 mark for two correct in order, 2 marks for all three correct.

short.q: State two ways of showing respect for the Bible.
short.answer: Keep it clean, carry it carefully, keep it in a high safe place, wash hands before reading, do not write in it.
short.working: 1 mark for each valid way.

short.q: Explain the meaning of the word "inspired" when we say the Bible is inspired by God.
short.answer: Inspired means that God guided the people who wrote the books. What they wrote is His message to people, so the Bible is God's word.
short.working: 1 mark for God guiding the writers, 1 for the message being God's, 1 for the conclusion that the Bible is God's word.

short.q: Give three reasons why we should read the Bible.
short.answer: It teaches right from wrong, comforts us, helps us to know God, gives stories of people who followed God.
short.working: 1 mark for each valid reason.
